items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You see a man like Benny Goodman, Johnny Dodge, and them fellas used to play walking planets, man. [INTERVIEWEE] You don't hear that no more.

ctx.x: Why they had more brass bands then? They ain't got them now. They don't have any? I said they had more brass bands then they got now. Oh yeah.
What did they do with Benny's drum? Did they have that in the funeral? Yes sir.
